en.comment: at some point, this file should become empty and unnecessary.

event_deaths.one: These past cycles, m_c has split from the current thread. c_n mourns the loss of their Tribe mate, and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Tribe will miss where {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had been in their lives. Moments of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} take {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} final resting place.
event_deaths.many: These past cycles, %{insert} have split from the current thread. c_n mourns their loss, and their Tribe mates will miss where they had been in their lives. Moments of their lives are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to them take them to their final resting place.

event_shaken_grief.one: So much grief and death has taken its toll on the scavengers of c_n. %{insert} is particularly shaken by it.
event_shaken_grief.many: So much grief and death has taken its toll on the scavengers of c_n. %{insert} are particularly shaken by it.

en.condition_retire_adolescent: %{name} decides {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'d rather spend {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} time helping around camp and entertaining the kits; {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} warmly welcomed into the departers' shelter.
en.condition_retire_adolescent_ceremony: {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} given the name %{newname} in honor of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} contributions to %{clan}.
en.condition_retire_no_leader: m_c has decided to retire from normal Tribe duty and prepare a pilgrimage to the Void
en.condition_retire_normal: Seeing m_c struggling the last several cycles, lead_name approaches {PRONOUN/m_c/object} and promises that no one would think less of {PRONOUN/m_c/object} for retiring early, and that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} would still be a cherished member of the Tribe as they prepare to leave. m_c agrees; later that day, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} pilgrimage ceremony is held.
en.ceremony_closer: Visit lead_name's profile to see {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} full leader ceremony.
en.ceremony_deputy_none: There are no scavengers fit to become deputy.

adoption_kittens_single.one: %{names} found a %{insert} and decides to adopt it.
adoption_kittens_single.many: %{names} found a %{insert} and decides to adopt them.

adoption_kittens_pair.one: %{names} found a %{insert} and decide to adopt it.
adoption_kittens_pair.many: %{names} found a %{insert} and decide to adopt them.

herbs_found.zero: med_name could not find any supplies this twelfth turn.

prey_catch_count.one: The Tribe managed to collect %{count} pip of food this twelfth turn.
prey_catch_count.many: The Tribe managed to collect %{count} pips of food this twelfth turn.

focus_prey.zero: Despite the focus of the Tribe, no additional food could be gathered.
focus_prey.one: With the heightened focus of the Tribe, %{count} additional pip of food was gathered.
focus_prey.many: With the heightened focus of the Tribe, %{count} additional pips of food were gathered.

focus_herbs.zero: Despite the focus of the Tribe, no additional herbs could be gathered.
focus_herbs.one: With the focus of the Tribe, %{herbs} was gathered.
focus_herbs.many: With the focus of the Tribe, %{herbs} were gathered.

focus_raid_prey.one: With the focus of the Tribe, %{count} pip of food was... acquired.
focus_raid_prey.many: With the focus of the Tribe, %{count} pips of food were... acquired.

focus_injury_hoarding.zero: Luckily, nobody in the Tribe got %{condition} due to hoarding.
focus_injury_hoarding.one: A scavenger got %{condition} due to hoarding supplies and food.
focus_injury_hoarding.many: Multiple scavengers got %{condition} due to hoarding supplies and food.

focus_injury_raiding.zero: Luckily, nobody in the Tribe got %{condition} during raids.
focus_injury_raiding.one: A scavenger got %{condition} while raiding other Tribes for more food.
focus_injury_raiding.many: Multiple scavengers got %{condition} while raiding other Tribes for more food.

en.event_lost1: After a long journey, m_c has finally returned home to c_n.
en.event_lost2: m_c was found at the border, tired but happy to be home.
en.event_lost3: m_c strides into camp, much to the everyone's surprise. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} home!
en.event_lost4: {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} met so many friends on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} journey, but c_n is where m_c truly belongs. With a tearful goodbye, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/return/returns} home.
en.event_returning_child_of_lost: m_c approaches the Tribe and asks to join, claiming to be %{parent_name}'s kit.

kittencough_spread.one: Kit-sickness has spread around the crèche. %{kits} is affected.
kittencough_spread.many: Kit-sickness has spread around the crèche. %{kits} are affected.

flea_spread.one: Fleas have been hopping from pelt to pelt and now %{cats} is infested.
flea_spread.two: Fleas have been hopping from pelt to pelt and now %{cats} are both infested.
flea_spread.many: Fleas have been hopping from pelt to pelt and now %{cats} are all infested.

en.illness_spread: %{illness} has spread around the camp. %{cats} have been infected.
en.scar_event0: m_c's %{injury} has healed, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'ll always carry evidence of it on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} pelt.
en.scar_event1: m_c healed from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} %{injury} but will forever be marked by a scar.
en.scar_event2: m_c's %{injury} has healed, but the injury left {PRONOUN/m_c/object} scarred.
en.move_on_dead_mate: m_c will always love r_c, but has decided to move on.

expired_prey.one: A pip of food expired and was removed from the pantry.
expired_prey.many: %{count} pips of food expired and were removed from the pantry.

consumed_prey.one: One pip of food was consumed.
